run_dl3dv_dataset_cli: run the DL3DV dataset CLI to load and visualize scenes from the WAI format dataset
create_dl3dvwai_dataset: create a DL3DVWAI dataset instance with a specified split, resolution, and MVS confidence threshold
load_dl3dv_scene_views: load views from a DL3DV scene including images, depth maps, camera poses, and intrinsics
sample_dl3dv_view_indices: sample view indices from a DL3DV scene using pairwise covisibility for multi-view selection
filter_dl3dv_depth_by_confidence: filter MVS depth maps using a confidence threshold and non-ambiguous mask from MOGE2 predictions
